title: Kyle Louis would help solve the Broncos coverage woes at LB

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kyle Louis would help solve the Broncos coverage woes at LB
sources.description: One prospect who may interest the Denver Broncos on day 2 of the 2026 NFL Draft is Pittsburgh linebacker Kyle Louis. He is a 6-0, 220-pound linebacker prospect who is one of the more athletic linebacker prospects in the entire draft. If you are looking for a rangy and explosive coverage linebacker, Pittsburgh’s Kyle Louis […]
